`jfk-4s.wav` is the first four seconds of OpenAI Whisper's
[`tests/jfk.flac`](https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/tests/jfk.flac),
converted to mono PCM16 at 16 kHz with PyAV. The recording is President John F.
Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address (a US federal government work in the public domain).
It is real human speech, rather than the energy suite's modulated-noise fixtures.
